}}'''Estevan Tonarma''' is a Lord of the Land from [[Tear]] under the service of [[Sunamon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Estevan Tonarma}}

== Appearance ==
He is lanky with a hard jaw.

== Activities ==
He is one of the Lords under the command of [[Weiramon]]. He is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] where Rand is gathering a massive army for the imminent attack on [[Illian]].
